items.title: 9.1 Introduction to Design Thinking and Business Solutions

source_refs.note: Topic 9.1 with the chapter introduction (PDF 208, printed 205). The learning outcomes (PDF 207) are not reproduced. Short question 1 is answered from general knowledge, flagged. MCQ 1 (b) matches the key.

blocks.text: This chapter introduces entrepreneurship: the skills and strategies needed for business success, including innovation, creativity and problem-solving. It presents design thinking as a human-centred way to build solutions, and guides you through creating a business plan, gathering market insights and pitching ideas, as well as marketing and sales, financial concepts, communication, collaboration and iteration.
Design thinking and other creative methods help businesses tackle challenges and meet customers' needs better.
